title: Breaks and cracks upon 2nd use
text: Breaks and cracks upon 2nd use. I love the portion of these bowls. They are very easy to initially use, however after freezing a few of them they crack immediately, and after using the second time the lid cracks pretty bad. So I don’t know if I would re-order these, I might look for some thing with a heavier lid.
